scope: Additional checks 1 and limited 4 only; existing splice reconstruction, fragment-name support, sequence, frame, reference and HLA policies are unchanged

normal.coordinate_key: GRCh38 chromosome and exact exon-boundary endpoints; retrieve all resolvable source UIDs on both strands, regardless of gene assignment
normal.threshold_rationale: Reuse the native MSNAF normal-mean threshold, separately within each source tissue category. This is an operational screening rule, not a validated safety boundary or a cross-assay expression ratio.
normal.alias_aggregation: Per-sample maximum across same-coordinate same-strand UIDs; never add duplicate annotations of the same gap
normal.positive_opposite_strand_match: REVIEW; catalog strand alone cannot establish or exclude the same oriented transcript
normal.missing_coordinate_match: NOT_DETECTED_IN_SEARCHED_REFERENCE; mean remains null, not an imputed measured zero
normal.same_strand_tissue_mean_at_or_above_thre: REVIEW; exclude from automatic primary selection
normal.unknown_tissue: REVIEW if a detected same-strand match has missing tissue metadata
normal.normal_source_strand: Catalog annotation, not independent molecular orientation; retained explicitly

strand.inference: Infer read-1 orientation at unambiguous annotated CDS-to-CDS junctions using BAM flags; do not use XS or splice motif as the orientation observation
strand.window_rule: A strict majority of evaluable named full-window witnesses must agree with the nominated gene under the measured library orientation. Missing, conflicting and tied evidence is REVIEW. No distinct-alignment-pattern minimum is added.
strand.XS: REPORT_ONLY; STAR intron-motif-derived XS is not independent strand evidence

selection.expression_and_affinity_scores: Reuse unchanged recorded scores for unchanged sequences; never claim new model inference
